## Research software

<div class="resource-grid">
<article class="resource-card">

<div class="resource-links"><a href="https://github.com/lorenzonava96/SAR-and-DL-for-Landslide-Rapid-Assessment">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a><a href="https://zenodo.org/records/17328763">Zenodo archive <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a><a href="https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-19-167-2026">Paper <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div>

## Datasets & models

<div class="resource-grid">
